name: SellGang
description: SellGang is a hybrid, mixed-affiliation street gang originating around the Sussex and Fenkell corridor (S-Block) in Detroit. The group developed alongside Sham Gang before branching into Murdaville, considered the younger faction. SellGang is a core member of the self-created '9s' alliance, which also includes Murdaville, LTK, and 928. Members use the 'Villains' moniker and purple-heart symbolism. While loosely rooted in Crip lineage, the group carries a fluid identity, with members claiming Blood, Crip, or simply '9' depending on context. Memorial identities CMW and 928 are central to group mythology.

sources.title: Understanding Hybrid and Mixed-Affiliation Groups in Metro Detroit
